title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ProductOffering
description: Represents entities that are orderable from the provider of the catalog, this resource includes pricing information. (TM Forum TMF620 Product Catalog Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ProductOffering; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOffering:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProductOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ProductOffering' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOffering:<tmfId>. unique identifier

isBundle.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/isBundle'. isBundle determines whether a productOffering represents a single productOffering (false), or a bundle of productOfferings (true).

isSellable.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/isSellable'. A flag indicating if this product offer can be sold stand-alone for sale or not. If this flag is false it indicates that the offer can only be sold within a bundle.

statusReason.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/statusReason'. A string providing a complementary information on the value of the lifecycle status attribute.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/validFor'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

place.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/place'. Place defines the places where the products are sold or delivered.

serviceLevelAgreement.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/serviceLevelAgreement'. ServiceLevelAgreement reference: A service level agreement (SLA) is a type of agreement that represents a formal negotiated agreement between two parties designed to create a common understanding about products, services, priorities, responsibilities, and so forth. The SLA is a set of appropriate procedures and targets formally or informally agreed between parties in order to achieve and maintain specified Quality of Service.

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/channel'. The channel defines the channel for selling product offerings.

serviceCandidate.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/serviceCandidate'. ServiceCandidate reference. ServiceCandidate is an entity that makes a ServiceSpecification available to a catalog. In TMF this is a ServiceCandidateRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ServiceCandidate entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCandidate:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

category.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/category'. The category resource is used to group product offerings, service and resource candidates in logical containers. Categories can contain other categories and/or product offerings, resource or service candidates. In TMF this is an array of CategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Category entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

resourceCandidate.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/resourceCandidate'. ResourceCandidate is an entity that makes a resource specification available to a catalog. A ResourceCandidate and its associated resource specification may be published - made visible - in any number of resource catalogs, or in none. In TMF this is a ResourceCandidateRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ResourceCandidate entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ResourceCandidate:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

productOfferingTerm.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/productOfferingTerm'. A condition under which a ProductOffering is made available to Customers. For instance, a productOffering can be offered with multiple commitment periods.

productOfferingPrice.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/productOfferingPrice'. An amount, usually of money, that is asked for or allowed when a ProductOffering is bought, rented, or leased. The price is valid for a defined period of time and may not represent the actual price paid by a customer. In TMF this is an array of ProductOfferingPriceRefOrValue objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ProductOfferingPrice entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOfferingPrice:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

agreement.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/agreement'. An agreement represents a contract or arrangement, either written or verbal and sometimes enforceable by law, such as a service level agreement or a customer price agreement. An agreement involves a number of other business entities, such as products, services, and resources and/or their specifications. In TMF this is an array of AgreementRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Agreement entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Agreement:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

bundledProductOffering.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/bundledProductOffering'. A type of ProductOffering that belongs to a grouping of ProductOfferings made available to the market. It inherits of all attributes of ProductOffering.

bundledGroupProductOffering.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/bundledGroupProductOffering'. A group of ProductOfferings that can be selected for instantiation, e.g. between 2 and 7 from a list of 15 channel packs.

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/attachment'. Complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures...

marketSegment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/marketSegment'. provides references to the corresponding market segment as target of product offerings. A market segment is grouping of Parties, GeographicAreas, SalesChannels, and so forth.

productOfferingRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/productOfferingRelationship'. A relationship between this product offering and other product offerings.

productOfferingCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/productOfferingCharacteristic'. A characteristic quality or distinctive feature of a ProductOffering. The characteristic can take on a discrete value fixed at design (catalog authoring) time, such as Mobile Plan Rank, and is not generally modifiable at inventory level.

prodSpecCharValueUse.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/prodSpecCharValueUse'. A use of the ProductSpecificationCharacteristicValue by a ProductOffering to which additional properties (attributes) apply or override the properties of similar properties contained in ProductSpecificationCharacteristicValue. It should be noted that characteristics which their value(s) addressed by this object must exist in corresponding product specification. The available characteristic values for a ProductSpecificationCharacteristic in a Product specification can be modified at the ProductOffering level. For example, a characteristic 'Color' might have values White, Blue, Green, and Red. But, the list of values can be restricted to e.g. White and Blue in an associated product offering. It should be noted that the list of values in 'ProductSpecificationCharacteristicValueUse' is a strict subset of the list of values as defined in the corresponding product specification characteristics.

policy.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/policy'. The Policy resource represents a policy/rule applied to ProductOffering.

allowedAction.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/allowedAction'. List of actions that can be executed (in context of a product order) on products instantiated from this offering

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status

productSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/productSpecification'. externalIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductOffering/properties/externalIdentifier'. List of external identifieers for the offering, e.g. identifier in source catalog

channel.description: A list of sales channels in which this action is allowed; for instance Remove might be allowed only in an assisted channel not in a self-service channel

allOf.description: Complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures...

url.description: Uniform Resource Locator, is a web page address (a subset of URI)

content.description: The actual contents of the attachment object, if embedded, encoded as base64

attachmentType.description: a business characterization of the purpose of the attachment, for example logo, instructionManual, contractCopy

mimeType.description: a technical characterization of the attachment content format using IETF Mime Types

allOf.description: Attachment reference. An attachment complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures

description.description: A narrative text describing the content of the attachment

AttachmentRefOrValue.description: The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the Attachment entity and not the AttachmentRefOrValue class itself

allOf.description: A group of product offerings that can be chosen for instantiation of children of the parent product offering, for example a list of channels for selection under a TV offering. Sometimes known as Selection Group. The group can also hierarchically contain other groups

id.description: Locally unique identifier of the group, useful in case the parent product offering or group includes multiple groups.

name.description: The name of the group of child offerings. Required to distinguish several choice groups.

bundledProductOffering.description: Child offerings, from which instances can be created as direct or hierarchically indirect children of the parent offering.

bundledGroupProductOffering.description: Child groups of product offerings, to enable hierarchical sub-grouping.

allOf.description: Defines for a BundledProductOfferingGroup (i.e. a group of multiple child offerings of a parent product offering), how many instances from the child offerings can be chosen in total. For example facilitate the choice of between 2 and 7 channel packs from a list, and cause certain items to be selected by default

numberRelOfferLowerLimit.description: The minimum total number of instances of the child offerings directly of hierarchically in the group that should be instantiated

numberRelOfferUpperLimit.description: The maximum total number of instances of the child offerings directly of hierarchically in the group that should be instantiated

allOf.description: Represents a containment of a product offering within another product offering, including specification of cardinality (e.g. is the bundled offering mandatory, how many times can it be instantiated in the parent product, etc.).
A set of numbers that specifies the lower and upper limits for a ProductOffering that can be procured as part of the related BundledProductOffering. Values can range from 0 to unbounded

numberRelOfferDefault.description: Default number of produc offereings that should be procured as part of the related BundledProductOffering

numberRelOfferLowerLimit.description: lower limit for a product offering that can be procured as part of the related BundledProductOffering

numberRelOfferUpperLimit.description: upper limit for a product offering that can be procured as part of the related BundledProductOffering

ChannelRef.description: The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

allOf.description: This class defines a characteristic specification.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which this characteristic specification is known and distinguished from other characteristic specifications.

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

description.description: A narrative that explains the CharacteristicSpecification.

configurable.description: If true, the Boolean indicates that the target Characteristic is configurable

minCardinality.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where zero is the value for the minCardinality.

maxCardinality.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where five is the value for the maxCardinality.

isUnique.description: Specifies if the value of this characteristic is unique across all entities instantiated from the specification that uses this characteristc. For example, consider a ProductSpecification for a set-top box, with a CharacteristicSpecification cardID. Each set-top box must have a different value for cardID, so this isUnique attribute would be set to true for the characteristic.

regex.description: A rule or principle represented in regular expression used to derive the value of a characteristic value.

extensible.description: An indicator that specifies that the values for the characteristic can be extended by adding new values when instantiating a characteristic for a resource.

@valueSchemaLocation.description: This (optional) field provides a link to the schema describing the value type.

charSpecRelationship.description: An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Specification Characteristics.

characteristicValueSpecification.description: A CharacteristicValueSpecification object is used to define a set of attributes, each of which can be assigned to a corresponding set of attributes in a CharacteristicSpecification object. The values of the attributes in the CharacteristicValueSpecification object describe the values of the attributes that a corresponding Characteristic object can take on.

allOf.description: An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Characteristic specifications. The specification characteristic is embedded within the specification whose ID and href are in this entity, and identified by its ID.

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship such as aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency, exclusivity

name.description: Name of the target characteristic within the specification

characteristicSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the characteristic within the specification

parentSpecificationHref.description: Hyperlink reference to the parent specification containing the target characteristic

parentSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the parent specification containing the target characteristic

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic value can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

isDefault.description: If true, the Boolean Indicates if the value is the default value for a characteristic

unitOfMeasure.description: A length, surface, volume, dry measure, liquid measure, money, weight, time, and the like. In general, a determinate quantity or magnitude of the kind designated, taken as a standard of comparison for others of the same kind, in assigning to them numerical values, as 1 foot, 1 yard, 1 mile, 1 square foot.

valueFrom.description: The low range value that a characteristic can take on

valueTo.description: The upper range value that a characteristic can take on

rangeInterval.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the valueFrom and valueTo attributes. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

regex.description: A regular expression constraint for given value

Duration.description: A time interval in a given unit of time

amount.description: Time interval (number of seconds, minutes, hours, etc.)

allOf.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.
